title: AnyHarness lockfile (harness/extensions.lock)
description: Machine-readable schema for ~/.agents/harness/extensions.lock (spec/lockfile.md). The spec text is authoritative if it conflicts with this schema.

$schema.description: Canonical schema identifier for this document.

extensions.description: Map from Extension directory name to Extension entry.

ManifestRef.description: Pointer to the extension's manifest plus the version resolved at install time. Mirrored from store-layout.schema.json/$defs/ManifestRef.

type.description: Source type (closed enum; new types are a spec minor change).

uri.description: Canonical source identifier: clone URL, owner/repo, registry coordinates, or local path.

ref.description: Resolved revision. For git/github sources the installer records the commit SHA, not a floating ref.

path.description: Subpath within the source containing the package (monorepo sources).

ComponentRef.description: Inventory record of one contributed component.

integrity.description: SRI-syntax sha256 digest of the installed package tree's manifest-of-files (lockfile.md §4).

treeHash.description: Optional GitHub tree SHA for github sources (skills.sh skillFolderHash convention) for cheap remote update checks.

installedAt.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of first install.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of last update; equals installedAt until first update.

targets.description: Harness identifiers the extension was materialized/emitted to.

capabilities.description: Capability slots granted at install time.

attestations.description: Reserved for signing/provenance attestations (trust.md §5); entries are opaque to the lockfile.
